pages.text: This difficult boss, capable of breaking blocks and attracting the player to himself, is imprisoned in a special Prison.$(br)It is located in the Overworld.

pages.title: The Cursed Prison
pages.text: A large structure in cold forests.

pages.title: Eye of Curse
pages.text: It's necessary to find the Cursed Prison

To enter the hall with the boss, you need to press the RMB on the gate. There will be a tombstone at the end of the hall, here we also press the RMB and start the battle!$(br)He is capable of dealing quite a lot of damage in a short period of time, and it is also difficult to dodge his attacks (especially in heavy armor).
Accumulating 5 charges, under the health bar, can cause huge damage. If he catches it by throwing it on the floor, there is very little chance of survival.
